modules.name: Sailor Events
modules.description: Event timers, spoken reminders and an in-game overlay for Arabian Dawn and Pirate Odyssey.
permissions: Reads which window is in front to show the overlay only over the game

modules.name: SRO Hider
modules.description: Hide and show Silkroad clients without closing them, from Companion, the tray or Ctrl+Alt+H.

modules.name: SRO Sleep
modules.description: Wakes you with an alarm when the game disconnects, your character dies or the client crashes.
permissions: Looks at the game window every 3 seconds while watching (nothing is saved or sent)
Plays a sound and shows Windows notifications
Can shut the PC down after a crash, only if you turn it on

modules.name: Sailor Fixer
modules.description: The Sailor Fixer repair tool. Companion downloads it and starts it in its own window.
permissions: Starts Sailor Fixer with administrator rights (Windows asks first)
